verses.text: God . . . has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ.
verses.title: Hope in Loss

verses.text: Submission to Governing Authorities Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established. The authorities that exist have been established by God.
Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
